title: Compass regression captainlog — onboarding evals & promptset watchlist (2026-06-07)
content:
Compass regression captainlog — onboarding evals & promptset watchlist (biweekly)
Date range: 2026-05-24 -> 2026-06-06
Owner: Janelle Park (eng-applied-ml) — contact: janelle@redwood.ai
Purpose: quick operational digest for the onboarding/evals queue. Emphasis on: newly onboarded models + promptsets, trending failure patterns, triage summary, and concrete action items for SRE, runtime, and prompt engineering.

Executive summary:
- Signal: overall onboarding regression rate rose to 3.8% (weighted by active promptsets) over the last two weeks, up from 1.1% baseline two cycles ago. This is concentrated in 3 prompt cohorts (finance: hallucinations, assistant-formatting: list/markdown loss, and long-context summarization: truncation/omission).
- Impact: Affects ~12 active customers in staging/dedicated onboarding flows; 2 customers reported flaky outputs to Solutions (CS ticket refs in linked_artifacts). No production SLA breaches yet, but several customers are paused in onboarding.
- Probable drivers: (1) a quantized model variant rollout on dedicated (Q4->Q8 quantization profile mismatch for some layers); (2) autoscaling microburst behavior causing KV cache warm-up regressions; (3) recent prompt normalization change (strip trailing whitespace + sentence-trimming) in the prompt-service (PR referenced above).

Key metrics (cohort-level):
- Total promptsets monitored: 214 (onboard + candidate sets)
- Promptset-level regression rate (>=1 failing example / 100 evals): 3.8% (8/214)
- Median latency to first-failure alert: 6 hours after deployment change
- Top 3 failure-mode prevalence (by distinct promptset count): hallucination/insertion 41%, format-loss 31%, truncation/omission 21% (others 7%)

Top failure clusters (examples + quick notes):
1) Finance-QA hallucination spike — cohort: finance-structured-qa (7 promptsets)
   - Symptom: confident but incorrect numeric attributions and invented legislation references.
   - Example input (shortened): "Summarize impact of RBC policy change on IFRS revenue recognition for Q2"
   - Failure exemplar: "The RBC policy mandates forward-recognition under IFRS 17 which increases revenue by 3.4%" — incorrect reference, model hallucinates policy name and numeric.
   - Observed after: rollout of the q8-lite quantization profile to dedicated pools (2026-05-28).
   - Hypothesis: quantization perturbation worsens factual grounding for dense numeric tokens in finance vocabulary.
   - Immediate mitigation: pin affected customers to q4 profile; disable q8-lite in the region (Mateo assigned).

2) Assistant-formatting lost bullets/markdown — cohort: doc-assistant-templates (12 promptsets)
   - Symptom: previously stable markdown list markers are now concatenated into a paragraph.
   - Example input: "Create checklist: 1) on-call steps 2) rollback procedure"
   - Failure exemplar output: "Create checklist: on-call steps rollback procedure" (no numbering/line breaks).
   - Observed correlation: prompt-service normalization change (whitespace trim + strip trailing separators) merged with a token-merging behavior under a new tokenizer patch.
   - Hypothesis: tokenization + normalization pipeline accidentally removes soft separators; generation decoding temp interacts with detokenization.
   - Immediate mitigation: revert prompt normalization change for assistant templates (Priya assigned); runtime to add a detokenization test in CI (Samir assigned).

3) Long-context summarization truncation — cohort: transcript-summarizer (5 promptsets)
   - Symptom: omission of final segments when context > 12k tokens; summaries cut mid-sentence.
   - Example input: multi-turn call transcript ~14k tokens; expected summary includes action items from last 10 minutes.
   - Failure exemplar: last 8 minutes of action items missing.
   - Observed cause: autoscaling cooldowns producing short-lived worker churn + KV cache cold starts; runtime logs show repeated expensive KV reconciliation events around p50-latency spikes.
   - Immediate mitigation: increase minimum pool size for long-context workers to avoid churn (Riley assigned), and enable experimental prewarmed cache for long-context routes.

Signal analysis notes (what we checked):
- Cross-checked failing examples against raw promptsets: confirmed that 93% of flagged failures reproduce deterministically under the latest model + runtime variant.
- Performed A/B regressions: onboarded model kept same weights; variant change was quantization + runtime patch. Isolated variables by running the same model on a golden runtime (no quantization) — regressions disappeared.
- Telemetry: token-level perplexity and stop-token distribution shifted in flagged prompts after the runtime change.

Proposed short-term runbook (0–72h):
- Block rollout of q8-lite across all dedicated pools until a focused test completes (Mateo) — deadline: 2026-06-09 18:00 PT.
- Revert prompt normalization change for assistant/template promptsets (Priya) — deadline: 2026-06-08 12:00 PT.
- Increase long-context worker min-pool in staging and one dedicated region; enable prewarm cache flag for transcript-summarizer route (Riley) — deadline: 2026-06-09 12:00 PT.
- Create synthetic promptset fuzz harness for finance-structured-qa with emphasis on numeric tokens (Janelle + Applied-ML infra) — deliverable: reproduce + tolerance matrix by 2026-06-14.

Medium-term (2–6 weeks):
- Run controlled quantization sensitivity sweep across finance vocab subsets; capture per-token logit shifts and human-evaluated hallucination rates (Research lead: Samir).
- Add lightweight detokenization regression tests to CI that assert list/markdown markers remain after normalization/roundtrip (Devex + Runtime).
- Expand the onboarding eval dashboard to surface per-promptset token-distribution diffs alongside regression flags (Product: Observability).

Owners & action tracker (short):
- Mateo Alvarez — rollback q8-lite & rollout block (JIRA: JIRA-ML-1284) — status: in_progress.
- Priya Natarajan — prompt normalization revert for assistant templates — status: in_progress.
- Riley Chen — long-context min-pool + prewarm cache toggle — status: in_progress.
- Samir Gupta — quantization sensitivity plan + research help — status: todo.
- Janelle Park — synthetic finance fuzz harness + report — status: todo.

Customer-facing notes (what Solutions should say):
- Proactive message template: "We're investigating a regression that may affect formatting and factual precision for certain prompt types while we investigate a runtime/quantization change. We've paused the wider rollout and are applying targeted fixes. We'll update within 48 hours with next steps specific to your onboarding flow."
- Action for CS: flag customers in onboarding group 'A' and offer a staged pin to stable runtime (contact Mateo).

Monitoring & alert tuning suggestions:
- Lowered detection threshold temporarily for 'format-loss' on assistant templates to 2 failing examples / 100 evals while we stabilize.
- Add a signal that correlates 'token-boundary token-merge rate' (detokenization diffs) with format-loss alerts for faster triage.

Unresolved questions / notes to self:
- Is the quantization sensitivity isolated to q8-lite only, or is it an interaction between q8-lite + a specific kernel selection on the dedicated GPU driver? (Need infra kernel logs).
- Can we add golden-answer checkpoints for finance promptsets (human labeled) into the onboarding eval harness? That will accelerate false-positive reduction.
- Evaluate whether detokenization inconsistencies are upstream (tokenizer model) or in our prompt-service pipeline after normalization.

Appendix — reproducible failing examples (redacted):
- Finance-1 (input snippet): "According to the latest central bank guidance, how should banks treat deferred revenue?"
  - Failing output (model-q8-lite): "Banks must treat deferred revenue under new guidance as immediate revenue recognized under IFRS-9 clause B12.3"
  - Expected safe output: "Depends on instrument; typically deferred revenue is recognized when performance obligations are satisfied — see IFRS guidance."

- Template-4 (input): "Write a 3-step rollback checklist for service X"
  - Failing output: "Write a 3-step rollback checklist for service X" (no bullet lines)
  - Expected: line-separated numbered bullets.

Quick experiment logs (links):
- Golden runtime run: success -> regressions not reproduced (link: GITHUB-PR-4852)
- Quant sweep start: queued (research sandbox)

Closing notes:
This captainlog should be used for coordination only — not the canonical post-mortem. If we stabilize within 72h, I'll convert this into a brief postmortem draft with root cause and follow-up backlog items. Please add comments below or ping on slack #applied-ml.

Notes to self: tag customers affected in the onboarding spreadsheet (Confluence-ONBOARD-42) and follow up with a short readout for execs if mitigation extends beyond 72h.

-- Janelle P. (on behalf of Applied ML quality ops)
